news.story: Peterson's scoring has cooled considerably after four consecutive 20-point performances earlier this month. He's averaged 13.4 points in 28.2 minutes over his last five games, but Lauri Markkanen's (hand) absence should continue providing opportunities for the rookie.

news.headline: Peterson produced 20 points (7-20 FG, 0-7 3Pt, 6-8 FT), 10 rebounds, eight assists, two steals and one block over 32 minutes in Friday's 111-101 loss to the Suns.
news.story: This was an excellent bounce-back performance from Peterson, who was limited to just 11 points over 19 foul-plagued minutes in Wednesday's win over the Lakers. He recorded the first double-double of his career, and to put a bow on the sterling outing, the rookie finished the game with just one turnover.

news.headline: Peterson ended Wednesday's 109-97 win over the Lakers with 11 points (3-5 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 4-6 FT), one rebound and three assists over 19 minutes.

news.story: Bryant saw 20 minutes of action for the first time this season in this blowout victory. However, the second-year forward didn't deliver his most efficient effort. He's logged double-digit minutes in three of his last five appearances, averaging 3.8 points and 1.6 rebounds in 11.8 minutes per tilt over that stretch.

news.headline: Carter Bryant drains 3 vs. LA Clippers
Bryant recorded zero points (0-1 FG, 0-1 3Pt) across two minutes during Tuesday's 105-93 loss to Detroit.
news.story: Bryant has gone scoreless in consecutive appearances, playing just seven combined minutes after averaging 9.0 points across his previous two outings. The second-year forward has seen his playing time decline sharply from 19 to five to two minutes over his last three games. His inconsistent role in San Antonio's rotation leaves him with minimal fantasy value outside deeper dynasty leagues.

news.headline: Darius Acuff Jr. gets the basket plus the foul
Acuff supplied 18 points (8-23 FG, 2-11 3Pt), one rebound, 12 assists and one steal over 36 minutes during Friday's 106-104 loss to the Lakers.
news.story: Acuff shot poorly two nights after a 36-point explosion against Phoenix, but he still ran the offense well. He led the Kings in assists and set up De'Andre Hunter's game-tying basket late. The 2026 No. 7 overall pick is averaging 25.7 points as a rookie and is one of the few bright spots for a Sacramento team that has fallen to 1-14.
